title: Shipping information
text:
Shipping Information
Delivery areas, times, and costs across Nigeria.
Delivery Areas
We deliver to all 36 states of Nigeria plus the FCT.
Delivery Times
Ilorin (Kwara State):
2–3 business days
Major cities (Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Kano, Ibadan):
4–5 business days
Other states:
5–7 business days
Shipping Costs
We offer
free nationwide delivery
on all combo orders during our launch promo period. After the promo, standard delivery rates will apply based on your state.
Cash on Delivery
Cash on Delivery (COD) is currently available
only for customers in Ilorin, Kwara State
. For all other locations, payment must be completed online before dispatch.
Order Processing
Orders are processed Monday–Saturday. Orders placed before 1:00 PM are usually dispatched the same day. Orders placed on Sundays or public holidays will be processed the next business day.
Tracking Your Order
Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via WhatsApp and email. You can also track your order anytime on our
Order Tracking
page.
Questions?
Need to know more about a specific location?
Chat with us on WhatsApp
— we usually respond within minutes.

title: Returns and refunds
text:
Returns & Refunds
Our 14-day return policy and refund process.
14-Day Return Policy
Not satisfied with your purchase? You can return any unused item in its original packaging within
14 days
of delivery for a full refund or exchange.
What Can Be Returned?
Items still in their original, unopened packaging
Items that have not been used or worn
Items with all original accessories, tags, and documentation
What Cannot Be Returned?
Items showing signs of wear, use, or damage
Items missing original packaging or accessories
Items returned more than 14 days after delivery
How to Return an Item
Contact us via WhatsApp or email within 14 days of delivery
Provide your order number and reason for return
We'll send you return instructions and address
Ship the item back to us using a trackable courier
We'll inspect the item within 2 business days of receipt
Refund or exchange will be processed within 5 business days
Refund Method
Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Bank transfer refunds typically arrive within 3–5 business days. Card refunds may take 7–10 business days depending on your bank.
Faulty or Damaged Items
If your item arrives faulty or damaged, contact us within
48 hours
of delivery with photos showing the issue. We cover all return shipping costs for faulty items and will send a replacement at no charge.
Warranty Claims
All products come with a
1-year manufacturer warranty
. Warranty claims are handled separately from returns —
contact us on WhatsApp
for warranty support.

title: Privacy policy
text:

Privacy Policy
How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
Last updated:
1. Introduction
Smart Combo NG ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our website or services.
2. Information We Collect
We collect the following types of information:
Personal information:
name, phone number, email, delivery address
Payment information:
processed securely by our payment Resellers (Paystack, Flutterwave) — we never store card details
Order information:
products purchased, delivery preferences
Usage data:
pages visited, browser type, device info (via standard analytics)
3. How We Use Your Information
To process and deliver your orders
To send order confirmations, shipping updates, and customer support messages
To respond to your inquiries
To improve our products, services, and website experience
To send promotional messages (only if you opt in)
4. Information Sharing
We do
not
sell your personal information. We share data only with:
Delivery Resellers (to ship your orders)
Payment processors (to handle transactions)
Service providers who help us operate the website (e.g. hosting, analytics)
Authorities, when legally required
5. Data Security
We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure servers, and limited internal access. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
6. Your Rights
You have the right to:
Access the personal data we hold about you
Request corrections to inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
Opt out of marketing communications at any time
7. Cookies
We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and analyze site usage. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features may not work properly.
